heading: Rule of construction regarding travel to and from school

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), nothing in this chapter shall authorize the Secretary to, or shall be construed to—

children.text: prohibit a child from traveling to and from school on foot or by car, bus, or bike when the parents of the child have given permission; or
expose parents to civil or criminal charges for allowing their child to responsibly and safely travel to and from school by a means the parents believe is age appropriate.

tree.heading: No preemption of State or local laws
tree.text: Notwithstanding subsection (a), nothing in this section shall be construed to preempt State or local laws.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Dec. 10, 2015, except with respect to certain noncompetitive programs and competitive programs, see section 5 of Pub. L. 114–95, set out as an Effective Date of 2015 Amendment note under section 6301 of this title.
